newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen starting steady, cabinet watch.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen starting steady, cabinet watch.

text.p: French shares were expected to open steady, with the market waiting for the announcement of the new Socialist government in the late afternoon, traders said.
Operators will also look to German bond reaction to Bonn compromise with Bundesbank on revaluation of gold reserves.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 23.04 points or 0.89 percent at 2,624.49. The CAC-40 futures contract on GLOBEX was down one at 2,603 from Tuesday's close.
* Accor, which rose sharply on Tuesday, may be featured, with restructuring plan to be announced at today's shareholders meeting.
* Cie des Signaux forecasts 50 to 100 million franc operating loss this year, positive margin from 1998.
* Prime Minister Lionel Jospin is due to announce cabinet likely to include a "Pink-Green-Red" alliance of moderate leftists, ecologists and Communists.
"The market will be looking at the allocation of cabinet posts, to see how that looks," a broker said. "It will be a wait and see type of day".
The market's strength has caught some by surprise, following Socialist win and expected entry of Communists into government.
